Compilation succeeded. The test class `FastDateParserAgentTest` is at `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDateParserAgentTest.java`, covering:

- Constructor contracts (pattern/timeZone/locale accessors, non-null `pattern`/`timeZone` throwing `NullPointerException`, null `locale` defaulting per the 4-arg ctor javadoc)
- `DateParser`/`Serializable` interface implementation, including a full serialization round-trip
- `parse(String)`, `parseObject(String)` happy path + `ParseException` on invalid/empty input
- `parse(String, ParsePosition)` / `parseObject(String, ParsePosition)` partial consumption and failure semantics (index unchanged, error index set)
- `parse(String, ParsePosition, Calendar)` success/failure, and the documented `IllegalArgumentException` for non-lenient calendars with out-of-range fields, plus lenient-mode normalization (including the "90 minutes → 1:30" example from the class javadoc)
- Time zone handling: explicit offset in pattern overriding the default zone, and the configured zone being used when the pattern has none
- Two-digit year resolution against a `centuryStart` window
- `equals`/`hashCode` contract (reflexive, null-safe, type-safe, and value-based equality/inequality)
- `toString`/`toStringAll` and `clear()` cache behavior

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
